title: 22-Year-Old Learning Her Lesson the Hard Way
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 19th, 2023. An officer was on patrol when he observed a woman who made an illegal turn after failing to obey a traffic control device. Upon conducting the traffic stop & running her license, he found out that her license had been suspended. When the officer made her aware that she had a suspended license, she became argumentative. The officer offered her a chance to call her boyfriend to come pick up the car but she got upset and started mumbling words under her breath, causing the officer to call a tow truck. This is footage of the events that followed.

Follow Us On Facebook: 
https://www.facebook.com/policewatch101/

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:
police101watch@gmail.com
